claim_boundary: fixed-weight global endpoint composite confirmation; no channel, route, causal, routing, adaptation, or learning claim
fitting_boundary: Fit the five noncarrier endpoint trackers, their base-train means/SDs, decoder and projections only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged to paired eval32 in both primary arms.
global_composite: For each eval history G is the mean standardized squared residual of fast, slow, control, message and gate endpoint trackers, standardized only with that tracker’s frozen base-train mean and population SD. Arm value is mean G over eval32; cG=base-upstream.
outcome: per-seed median over fixed projections 17/29/43 of delay8 base-minus-upstream true R2
gate: Pass only if cG<0 in at least 5/6 finite seeds and leave-one-seed-out Spearman(cG,outcome)<0 in at least 5/6 omissions. No alternate metric or mechanism follow-up on failure.
